name: How do I know if my emergency shutoff valve needs repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my emergency shutoff valve needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your emergency shutoff valve may need repair include difficulty turning it, a leaky valve, corrosion, or if it fails to completely stop the water supply. If you notice any of these issues, it's best to have a professional plumber inspect it. Delaying repair can lead to a non-functional valve when you need it most, making it impossible to mitigate a plumbing disaster effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: A leaky, corroded, or difficult-to-turn emergency shutoff valve, or one that doesn't fully stop water, indicates a need for repair.
